# Load data
```{r}
chromosome_coverage_data <- readRDS("./data/reference_genome_coverage/coverage/curated_datasets/FA1090_genome_coverage_summary_statistics.RDS")
gene_position_data <- readRDS("./data/PathogenWatch_AMR_coverage/coverage/curated_datasets/Pathogenwatch_gene_coverage_by_position.RDS")
gene_summary_statistics <- readRDS("./data/PathogenWatch_AMR_coverage/coverage/curated_datasets/Pathogenwatch_gene_coverage_summary_statistics.RDS")
gene_summary_statistics$mean_non_zero <- ifelse(is.na(gene_summary_statistics$mean_non_zero),0,gene_summary_statistics$mean_non_zero)
gene_summary_statistics$median_non_zero <- ifelse(is.na(gene_summary_statistics$median_non_zero),0,gene_summary_statistics$median_non_zero)
```

# Generate normalized data
## Gene position
```{r}
gene_position_data <- left_join(gene_position_data,chromosome_coverage_data %>% select(isolate,median,median_non_zero) %>% `colnames<-`(c("isolate","chromosome_median_depth","chromosome_median_non_zero_depth")))
gene_position_data$positional_chromosome_median_normalized_depth <- gene_position_data$Total_Depth / gene_position_data$chromosome_median_depth
gene_position_data$positional_chromosome_median_non_zero_normalized_depth <- gene_position_data$Total_Depth / gene_position_data$chromosome_median_non_zero_depth

saveRDS(gene_position_data,"./data/PathogenWatch_AMR_coverage/coverage/curated_datasets/Pathogenwatch_gene_coverage_by_position_chromosome_normalized.RDS")
```

## Gene level
```{r}
gene_summary_data <- left_join(gene_summary_statistics %>% select(isolate,reference,reference_location,genotype,median,median_non_zero) %>% rename("loci_median_depth" = "median",
                                                                                                                                                   "loci_median_non_zero_depth"="median_non_zero"),chromosome_coverage_data %>% select(isolate,median,median_non_zero) %>% `colnames<-`(c("isolate","chromosome_median_depth","chromosome_median_non_zero_depth")))

gene_summary_data$loci_chromosome_median_normalized_depth <- gene_summary_data$loci_median_depth / gene_summary_data$chromosome_median_depth
gene_summary_data$loci_chromosome_median_non_zero_normalized_depth <- gene_summary_data$loci_median_non_zero_depth / gene_summary_data$chromosome_median_non_zero_depth

saveRDS(gene_summary_data,"./data/PathogenWatch_AMR_coverage/coverage/curated_datasets/Pathogenwatch_gene_coverage_summary_statistics_chromosome_normalized.RDS")
```
